event: Those matches are likely other "count" names. Check for the specific incr_r registers in C tests.

I submitted the verdict as verified: all five items stand as untested.

I found no test that checks any of them. The only non-generated references to the count_incr registers are these:
- **`src/integration/test_suites/libs/mci/mci.c`:** it has register mask entries (lines 2088–2110). These are not stimulus, and none of them check a pulse, a decrement or saturation.
- **`src/mci/coverage/mci_top_cov_if.sv`:** it has coverpoints that only sample the signal. A coverpoint can't fail a test, so a wrong behaviour would go unnoticed.
- **Generated files:** the remaining matches are generated register and address-map files and the covergroup generator script, which are not tests.

My searches for the per-item behaviours (the decrement, the one-clock pulse, saturation and the counter field type) turned up no test or assertion. All of these searches were text searches for register and field names, so a check that exercises the behaviour without naming these registers could have been missed.
